sourceTitle: With the Harmony to Labrador Notes of a visit to the Moravian mission stations on the north-east coast of Labrador
description: "With the Harmony to Labrador" by Benjamin La Trobe is a historical account written in the late 19th century. The narrative revolves around La Trobe’s visit to the Moravian mission stations located on the northeast coast of Labrador, detailing his experiences and observations about the region and its inhabitants, particularly the Eskimo population.
